summary: Form checkbox that fills from the centre and draws its check, with a mixed state for parent and child selections.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled state: `true`, `false` or `"indeterminate"` (drawn as a dash). Use with `onCheckedChange`.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial state when uncontrolled. A form reset restores it.

props.name: value
props.description: Value submitted with the form when checked.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. Nothing is submitted while unchecked.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the checkbox, ignores click and Space and removes it from the tab order.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called when the user toggles the checkbox. Toggling the mixed state checks it.

accessibility: The root is a `role="checkbox"` element with `tabindex="0"` (`-1` while disabled), `aria-checked` set to `true`, `false` or `mixed`, and `aria-disabled` while disabled.
Its accessible name comes from the children.
Enter does not toggle; Space and click do.
The box is drawn on an `aria-hidden` canvas.
motion: With reduced motion the fill and check appear at once and the box does not pop.
form: With `name`, a hidden input submits `value` while checked, and nothing while unchecked or mixed. There is no validation. Form reset restores `defaultChecked` and calls `onCheckedChange` when that changes the state.
notes: Parent and child behaviour, such as an "All" box driving its children, is not built in: derive the parent's `checked` (`true`, `false` or `"indeterminate"`) from the children and set the children in its `onCheckedChange`.
The root carries `data-state` set to `checked`, `unchecked` or `indeterminate`.
